title: RD-MT162-LedgerExtensions

scope.summary:
GOAL: Extend the durable SurrealDB ledgers (ModelLane/EventLedger family + ProcessOwnershipLedger adjacency) with the WP-017 row families that make steering, attribution, MT runs, and merge actions durably queryable: steer-message rows (payload hash + ack state), parent-child attribution rows, MT-run join rows, and merge-action rows. All SurrealKit rollouts are forward-only and additive with written recovery/compensating-rollout notes, and every write path is FAIL-CLOSED exactly like the existing lanes: a failed ledger write fails the calling action — never a silent skip, never a fire-and-forget.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: (a) new file src/backend/handshake_core/src/swarm_orchestration/agent_steering_ledger.rs containing AgentSteeringLedgerStore (SurrealDbClient-backed, ModelLaneStore discipline) + row types + ensure_schema; (b) module registration in swarm_orchestration/mod.rs; (c) OPTIONAL minimal additive join-key surface in process_ledger/schema.rs ONLY if the MT-run rows need a column that cannot live in the new tables (prefer NOT touching process_ledger at all — join on existing session/process ids instead); (d) new test file src/backend/handshake_core/tests/agent_steering_ledger_tests.rs. No HTTP routes (MT-166), no FR emit call sites (family MTs), no transcript logic (MT-163).

DETAILED SPEC — ROW SCHEMAS (all tables are SCHEMAFULL SurrealDB tables defined by a SurrealKit rollout; stores use the official SDK, conditional revision-checked transactions, a typed record object stamped with schema_id, and updated_at_unix_ms int):

1. agent_steer_messages — one row per steer/interrupt/notify message:
   message_id typed record/string id (uuid v7, minted by the session model — HBR-INT-008),
   session_id required string (target session),
   sender_session_id optional string (null = operator-originated; non-null = model-to-model, MT-101..108),
   kind required string validated by a typed Rust enum ('steer','interrupt','notify','signal'),
   payload_sha256 required string (raw text NEVER stored here; transcript custody is MT-163's redaction-governed surface),
   payload_bytes required int,
   ack_state required string ('queued','delivered','acked','rejected') — mirrors FR-EVT-SESSION-STEER-{QUEUED,DELIVERED,ACKED,REJECTED} from MT-161 one-to-one,
   ack_detail optional string (rejection reason / ack kind),
   wp_id optional string, mt_id optional string, role_id optional string,
   revision required int, record_json required typed SurrealDB object (schema_id "hsk.agent_steer_message_row@1"), created_at_unix_ms required int, updated_at_unix_ms required int.
   Ack-state transitions are forward-only (queued->delivered->acked | queued/delivered->rejected); an upsert attempting a backward transition returns a typed error (fail closed), same discipline as MT-001's turn-state guard.

2. agent_parent_child_attribution — one row per spawned child session:
   child_session_id typed record/string id,
   parent_session_id required string,
   spawn_origin required string ('operator','m2m','scheduler'),
   spawn_request_message_id optional string (joins agent_steer_messages when m2m — FR-EVT-M2M-SPAWN-REQUESTED correlation),
   adapter_kind required string, worktree_id optional string, swarm_id optional string, wp_id optional string, mt_id optional string,
   denied required bool default false, denial_reason optional string (FR-EVT-M2M-SPAWN-DENIED lands as denied=true row so the audit surface can show refused spawns, not just successful ones),
   revision required int, record_json required typed SurrealDB object (schema_id "hsk.agent_attribution_row@1"), created_at_unix_ms required int, updated_at_unix_ms required int.

3. agent_mt_runs — join-key rows binding MT execution to sessions:
   run_id typed record/string id (uuid v7),
   wp_id required string, mt_id required string, session_id required string,
   worktree_id optional string, process_uuid optional string (joins the ProcessOwnershipLedger spawn rows WITHOUT modifying process_ledger tables),
   phase required string ('dispatched','signaled','handoff','completed','failed') — mirrors FR-EVT-MT-{DISPATCHED,SIGNALED,HANDOFF},
   to_session_id optional string (handoff target),
   revision required int, record_json required typed SurrealDB object (schema_id "hsk.agent_mt_run_row@1"), created_at_unix_ms required int, updated_at_unix_ms required int,
   UNIQUE (wp_id, mt_id, session_id, phase, created_at_unix_ms) is NOT used — instead append one row per phase change (run history, not a mutable state cell), ordered by created_at_unix_ms.

4. agent_merge_actions — one row per merge-back lifecycle step:
   merge_id required string, action_seq required int,
   typed compound record identity derived from merge_id and action_seq,
   worktree_id required string, session_id optional string (acting session), approved_by optional string,
   action required string ('proposed','approved','executed','conflicted','aborted') — mirrors FR-EVT-MERGE-* one-to-one,
   source_branch optional string, target_branch optional string, merged_sha optional string, conflict_count optional int,
   record_json required typed SurrealDB object (schema_id "hsk.agent_merge_action_row@1"), created_at_unix_ms required int.
   Append-only: no UPDATE path at all; the current merge state is the max(action_seq) row (audit-grade history for MT-166 and the merge family MT-141..148).

FAIL-CLOSED WRITE CONTRACT: every store method returns Result and the documented calling convention (enforced in the family MTs via this contract's acceptance text) is that the ACTION FAILS when the ledger write fails — matching record_message_with_payload_binding (model_lane.rs line 276: no ArtifactStore/EventLedger binding may be left behind) and the process-ledger writer's retained-retry accounting (process_ledger/writer.rs flush_failed_row_count line 64: failures are counted and retried, never dropped). No method swallows official SurrealDB Rust SDK errors; no best-effort spawn-and-forget writes.

FORWARD-ONLY ADDITIVE SURREALDB ROLLOUT + RECOVERY NOTES: SurrealKit defines SCHEMAFULL tables, fields and indexes through versioned rollout stages. Each table's Rust doc comment identifies the preceding SurrealDB rollout stage and the record schema_id bump procedure; rollback never reconnects to PostgreSQL. Existing tables (model_lanes, model_lane_messages line 438, swarm_session_cleanup_receipts line 93, process-ledger tables in process_ledger/table.rs) are NEVER altered.

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Read the grounding files first: swarm_orchestration/model_lane.rs lines 60-460 (store shape, upsert discipline, record_message_with_payload_binding fail-closed contract, lock-order comment line 342), process_ledger/writer.rs (WriterConfig 118, ProcessLedgerWriter 333, flush_failed_row_count 47-64), process_ledger/schema.rs + table.rs (existing row shapes — read-only), process_ledger/batcher.rs + reclaim.rs + escalation_router.rs (adjacent write/reclaim discipline — read-only), flight_recorder/event_ledger.rs (EventLedger authority stamping — read-only), and the MT-161 contract's event catalogue (ack_state/phase/action vocabularies must match its FR ids one-to-one).
2. Create agent_steering_ledger.rs: row structs (serde, Debug, Clone, PartialEq) + AgentSteeringLedgerStore { pool: SurrealDbClient } + ensure_schema with the four tables + indexes on (session_id), (parent_session_id), (wp_id, mt_id), (worktree_id), (created_at_unix_ms).
3. Implement the API: record_steer_message / advance_ack_state (forward-only guard, typed error backward), record_attribution (upsert by child_session_id; denied spawns recorded too), append_mt_run_phase (append-only), append_merge_action (append-only, next action_seq via MAX+1 inside a transaction to keep concurrent writers race-safe), list_* query methods filtered by session/parent/wp/mt/worktree/time-range (these are exactly the filters MT-166 needs; return ordered Vec<row>).
4. Stamp every record_json with its schema_id and mirror all queryable columns into the typed SurrealDB object (EventLedger custody discipline: the row is replayable from record_json alone).
5. Author tests/agent_steering_ledger_tests.rs (managed-SurrealDB gated like MT-001: HANDSHAKE_TEST_SURREALDB_ENDPOINT present -> run; absent -> typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF skip, never fake PASS): (a) ensure_schema idempotent (call twice); (b) steer-message ack forward path queued->delivered->acked green, backward acked->queued typed error; (c) rejected path with denial detail; (d) attribution row for m2m spawn joins its spawn_request_message_id; denied spawn row readable; (e) mt-run phase history append + ordered read; (f) merge action_seq monotonic under two concurrent appends (tokio join) — no duplicate (merge_id, action_seq); (g) fail-closed: a write against a poisoned/closed pool returns Err (no Ok-with-drop).
6. cargo build -p handshake_core green; clippy clean; no sqlite anywhere on these write paths.
forbidden_paths: app/src/** (except named surfaces; this MT names none)
.GOV/** (registry sync = governance closeout step, documented not coded)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/swarm_orchestration/model_lane.rs (existing lane tables KEPT AS-IS; pattern reference only)

src/backend/handshake_core/src/process_ledger/** (existing process-ledger tables KEPT AS-IS; join via process_uuid, do not alter — if a join key is truly impossible without it, STOP and escalate rather than edit)
src/frontend/** (no native UI in this MT)
acceptance_criteria: agent_steering_ledger.rs exists, is registered, and cargo build -p handshake_core is green.

Four tables exist with the contracted columns; ensure_schema is idempotent and issues only CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS statements (additive migration; proven by test calling it twice and by source grep).
Each table's doc comment carries an explicit ROLLBACK note (safe DROP rationale + record_json schema_id bump procedure).
agent_steer_messages stores payload_sha256 + payload_bytes and NEVER raw payload text (source grep + test with marker string).
Ack-state machine is forward-only; backward transitions return a typed error and persist nothing (fail closed).
agent_parent_child_attribution records BOTH granted and denied spawns (denied=true rows) with spawn_request_message_id join to agent_steer_messages for m2m.
agent_mt_runs is append-per-phase history joining wp_id/mt_id/session_id/process_uuid without any process_ledger table change (git diff on src/backend/handshake_core/src/process_ledger/ is empty).
agent_merge_actions is append-only (no UPDATE statement in the file) with race-safe monotonic action_seq proven under concurrent append.
Every store method is fail-closed: Result-returning, no swallowed official SurrealDB Rust SDK error, no fire-and-forget task::spawn writes (source review + poisoned-pool test).
record_json rows carry schema_ids hsk.agent_steer_message_row@1 / hsk.agent_attribution_row@1 / hsk.agent_mt_run_row@1 / hsk.agent_merge_action_row@1.
The real-SurrealDB integration suite runs and passes against a disposable scoped namespace/database; a missing managed endpoint is a typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF blocker, not a skip or pass.
Vocabularies (ack_state, phase, action) match the MT-161 FR event catalogue one-to-one (test asserts the string sets).
proof_targets: cargo test -p handshake_core agent_steering_ledger --nocapture 2>&1 | tee /tmp/mt162_run.txt && grep -E 'test result: ok' /tmp/mt162_run.txt
grep -n 'IF NOT EXISTS' src/backend/handshake_core/src/agent_steering_ledger.rs src/backend/handshake_core/src/swarm_orchestration/agent_steering_ledger.rs 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'IF NOT EXISTS'
expected_tests: ensure_schema idempotency (double call) + additive-only source assertion
ack forward-path green / backward-path typed error / rejected path
attribution rows for granted AND denied spawns with message-id join
merge action_seq monotonic under concurrent append (tokio join)
fail-closed poisoned-pool Err test + no-raw-payload marker test
vocabulary parity test vs MT-161 FR id catalogue
implementation_notes: Preserve the incumbent lock-order safety principle while replacing its physical mechanism: never hold an in-process mutex across a SurrealDB network transaction; perform the conditional EventLedger/domain write atomically in SurrealDB, then update in-process projections after commit.

process_uuid join: SwarmEvent::SessionSpawned already carries process_uuid (events.rs line 119) and the process ledger rows key on it — that is why agent_mt_runs can join ProcessOwnershipLedger without altering it.

Payload custody split is deliberate: ledgers hold hashes (audit joins), transcripts (MT-163) hold governed text, FR events (MT-161) hold hashes/previews. Keeping raw text out of SurrealDB rows keeps the audit export (MT-166) shareable as portable evidence without a redaction pass.

The escalation_router.rs / reclaim.rs read is context only: reclaim semantics for dead sessions with queued steer messages belong to the session family (MT-001..010), which will consume advance_ack_state('rejected', reason='session_reclaimed').

Rollback notes are documentation-grade (doc comments), not down-migration code — the project uses ensure_schema-style forward migration; the note must state the safe manual rollback and the schema_id bump procedure per GLOBAL recoverability preferences.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless durable-ledger MT; rows become operator-visible via the MT-166 audit pane. Durable SurrealDB rows with replayable record_json satisfy trace-projection reconstructability.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: No operator-usable behavior ships here; ledger semantics are documented for operators/models in the MT-165 manual entries (agent-harness observability section) and surfaced by MT-166.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations: flight_recorder: WIRED via MT-161 kinds — ledger writes and FR emissions are correlated by message_id/merge_id/run ids; no new FR kinds here
internal_diagnostics: typed DEFERRED(reason=WP-KERNEL-015-not-shipped) unless the internal_diagnostics tier exists at implementation time; disposition recorded by MT-164
palmistry: typed DEFERRED(reason=WP-KERNEL-015-not-shipped) unless Palmistry exists at implementation time; disposition recorded by MT-164
risk_if_missed: Steering, attribution, MT runs, and merges leave no durable queryable truth: acks are unprovable, who-spawned-whom is reconstructable only from volatile FR payload JSON, MT-166's audit joins have no SurrealDB side, and failed writes silently drop governance-relevant history.

risks: RISK-1: Silent-drop writes — a family MT wires a ledger write as fire-and-forget; on failure the action proceeds and audit history silently lies by omission.
RISK-2: Ack-state rollback — concurrent writers or a retry loop regress acked back to delivered/queued, corrupting the delivery proof MT-166 exposes.
RISK-3: Raw payload in SurrealDB — steer text (secrets, injection content per MT-104) lands verbatim in agent_steer_messages, making every audit export a leak surface.
RISK-4: process_ledger creep — a 'convenient' column is added to existing process-ledger tables, breaking the KEPT-AS-IS boundary and the WP-KERNEL-004 reclaim/escalation readers.
RISK-5: merge action_seq races — two sessions append concurrently, MAX+1 outside a transaction duplicates action_seq and the merge history becomes unordered.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): all store methods Result-returning with no internal task::spawn; poisoned-pool test proves Err propagation; the fail-closed calling convention is pinned in acceptance criteria that family MTs cite.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): forward-only guard implemented inside the store (single source of truth) with a backward-transition typed-error test; revision bump on every legal transition.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): schema has no payload text column at all — only payload_sha256/payload_bytes; marker-string test + source grep prove nothing raw is stored.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): process_ledger/** is a forbidden path; proof target asserts an empty git diff for that directory; join uses the existing process_uuid key.

CTRL-5 (RISK-5): action_seq allocation inside a transaction (a conditional SurrealDB transaction over the allocator record) with a concurrent-append test asserting no duplicate (merge_id, action_seq).

research_provenance.source: Grounded in wtc-multi-model-orchestration-v1: swarm_orchestration/model_lane.rs (ModelLaneStore line 60, cleanup-receipt INSERT line 93, record_message line 261, record_message_with_payload_binding fail-closed line 276, lock-order note line 342, model_lane_messages INSERT line 438, EventLedger authority stamps lines 1343-1385), process_ledger/writer.rs (flush_failed_row_count lines 47-64, WriterConfig 118, ProcessLedgerWriter 333 — retained-retry, never-drop discipline), process_ledger/{schema,table,batcher,reclaim,escalation_router}.rs (existing shapes, read-only), swarm_orchestration/events.rs (SessionSpawned carries process_uuid/parent_session_id/worktree_id, lines 116-122), MT-161 contract (FR id catalogue this MT's vocabularies mirror), MT-001 contract (store/newtype/managed-SurrealDB-gate precedent).
corrections: Stub said 'SurrealDB EventLedger/ModelLane + ProcessOwnershipLedger extensions' — verified the safe additive shape is NEW sibling tables in a new store module joining existing keys (process_uuid, session_id), NOT column changes to model_lane or process_ledger tables; contract forbids touching either and encodes the join instead.

agent_merge_actions designed append-only (no UPDATE) after reading the EventLedger custody pattern — current-state-as-latest-row is what the merge family and MT-166 audit need; rollback note discipline replaces down-migrations, matching the codebase's ensure_schema style.
Ack vocabulary pinned to MT-161's FR-EVT-SESSION-STEER-{QUEUED,DELIVERED,ACKED,REJECTED} with a parity test so ledger and FR never drift.

surrealdb_translation_v02_205.schema_rule: Any embedded PostgreSQL DDL/SQL snippet is a semantic field/index/invariant inventory only. Implement it as SCHEMAFULL SurrealQL through SurrealKit; do not execute or mechanically transliterate the snippet.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.concurrency_rule: Translate advisory locks, SKIP LOCKED and row locks into SurrealDB transactions, durable lease/fencing records and conditional updates with equivalent tests.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.notification_rule: Translate LISTEN/NOTIFY into scoped SurrealDB live queries plus bounded resynchronization.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.privacy_rule: Translate RLS into authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker; administrative credentials cannot prove privacy.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.proof_rule: All named storage proofs run against real SurrealDB. No PostgreSQL process, driver, connection, fixture, environment variable or fallback is permitted.
